projects.title: DataScope HR
projects.longDescription: DataScope HR is an AI-powered platform that helps HRIS teams search, generate, manage, and publish realistic HR test datasets through natural language. By combining NLP, hybrid search, and data quality controls, it makes HR test data faster to access, more reliable, and easier to maintain.
features: AI-powered HR test data management platform
Natural language search with NLP, semantic search, and full-text search
Synthetic HR data generation using Llama 3.2 + Ollama
Business-rule, consistency, and data-quality validation
Bidirectional Oracle ↔ PostgreSQL ETL
Dataset versioning, metadata, audit logging, and observability
FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Docker
Automated testing with Pytest & Cypress
CI/CD and enterprise-ready data governance

projects.title: UtopiaHire
projects.longDescription: UtopiaHire is an AI-powered career platform that helps job seekers analyze, optimize, and match with relevant job opportunities in real time. By combining resume intelligence, job scraping, and semantic matching, it delivers personalized recommendations while ensuring fairness through bias detection and privacy-by-design principles, making the job search process smarter, safer, and more effective. The platform was developed as part of the IEEE Computer Society Challenge at TSYP14.
features: AI-powered career platform for job seekers in MENA & Sub-Saharan Africa
Real-time job scraping and opportunity aggregation
AI-powered resume analysis and profile optimization
Semantic job matching using NLP and embeddings
Personalized job recommendations and skill-gap analysis
Bias detection and mitigation for fairer recommendations
Privacy-by-design with encryption and PII anonymization
Secure and ethical handling of user data
Scalable architecture with external data source integration
Focus on responsible, transparent, and inclusive AI

projects.title: SymBook
projects.longDescription: SymBook is a complete e-commerce web application for buying and selling books online. Book search, browsing, cart, and order management

AI-enhanced search for improved book discovery
Admin dashboard for books, categories, users, and orders
Advanced analytics & visualizations with Google Charts
Fully Dockerized for deployment and portability
Complete implementation of core and advanced features

projects.title: Tunisair Flights Management System
projects.longDescription: As part of the project, we built an intelligent flight scheduling system for Tunisair that automates aircraft and crew assignment based on availability and operational constraints. This solution streamlines planning, minimizes human error, and enhances operational efficiency in real-world aviation contexts.

Aircraft assignment based on capacity and availability
Crew assignment based on availability and planning
Automatic validation of aircraft maintenance status
Secure authentication with encrypted passwords
Flight, aircraft, and crew management
Powerful multi-criteria flight search
Scheduling validation to reduce human errors
Improved flight planning and operational efficiency
